zh: 选择项目时，临时项目收在一行。展开就能单独选，收起也能看见选了几项。
Astro 会记住你上次选的项目，包括全部清空。
Dreaming 会显示正在整理的项目和结果。「补检索词」会告诉你还有几条要补。
Windows 更新时连接可接续。长按宿主电脑的「设置」三秒，可以复制故障报告。
客户端连不上 FULI 时会显示下一步。需要确认数据格式更新时，可打开「设置 › 数据格式」。
en: Temporary projects share one row with a selection count. Expand it to pick them individually.
Astro remembers the projects you selected, including an empty selection.
Dreaming shows its current project and results. Retrieval terms shows how many entries remain.
Windows clients reconnect after updates. Hold Settings on the host for 3 seconds to copy a report.
MCP clients show the recovery step, including when to open Settings › Data format.
